# American Baseball Coaches Association (ABCA)

> > The American Baseball Coaches Association is the premier professional development organization for baseball coaches, offering educational resources, conventions, clinics, and community through Inside Pitch Magazine, the ABCA Video Library, and annual events.

ABCA serves baseball coaches at all levels with coaching education, professional development opportunities, and access to industry-leading resources. The organization hosts the annual ABCA Convention in Chicago, produces Inside Pitch Magazine and the ABCA Podcast, and partners with companies like Rapsodo, GameChanger, and Cap America to support the coaching community.
